summary: Implemented nearcade.phizone.cn scraper (primary) and optional WAHLAP Groove Coaster China scraper. Discovered live public API: GET /api/shops?page=N&regionId=CN (48/page, totalCount 3941 CN), GET /api/shops/{id}, GET /api/regions. List payload already includes full per-cab lineups (titleId, quantity, cost, version), GeoJSON Point coords, openingHours, isOpen. Mapped titleIds to GAME_SLUGS (maimai_dx, chunithm, sdvx, taiko, wacca, groove_coaster, pump_it_up, etc.; unmapped -> other with names in notes). Full CN crawl wrote data_raw/nearcade.json with 3941 unique source_url-keyed rows. wahlap_gc writes china_wahlap_gc.json (31 shops, groove_coaster only). Did not touch bemanicn.py/wahlap.py; did not wire merge.
how_to_verify: Expect stderr: totalCount=3941 regionId=CN page size ~48; smoke: 48 rows (nothing written)

python -c "import json; r=json.load(open('data_raw/nearcade.json',encoding='utf-8')); print(len(r), r[0]['source_url']); h=[x for x in r if x['name']=='街机烈火'][0]; print(h['games'][:8], h['game_counts'])"
Confirm scrapers/bemanicn.py and scrapers/wahlap.py are unchanged (git status / diff)
risks: Merge is NOT wired: nearcade rows sit in data_raw/nearcade.json only. Deduping against bemanicn is required later (shop ids often look like 10000+bemanicn_id; names/addresses overlap heavily).
Coords labeled gcj02 (Tencent maps). Do not plot as WGS-84 without eviltransform.
Community-edited lineups can diverge from official WAHLAP/BemaniCN; treat as enrichment/override layer, not sole authority.
isOpen=false marks 94 closed shops; some names still say 闭店 while isOpen=true (upgrade-in-progress prose).
titleId 2 (maimai classic) intentionally maps to other per GAME_SLUGS policy; racing/Initial D/Wangan/Pokemon stay other.
API page size and regionId filter are observed, not documented; if page size changes, scraper still follows hasNextPage.
wahlap_gc source_url is the REST list URL for all rows (no per-shop page); merge by name/address only.
Full crawl is ~83 polite requests (~1-2 min); IncompleteRead retries via common.fetch.
